title: Iodine in urine
what: This urine test shows how much iodine your body gets from food.
why: To check for too little or too much iodine: with thyroid conditions, in pregnancy, and before radioactive iodine treatment.
duration: urine collection takes a few minutes or 24 hours; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: If you take vitamins or supplements with iodine
If you recently had a CT scan or another test with contrast dye
If you put iodine on your skin or use mouthwash with iodine
If you are pregnant or breastfeeding

prepare.title: Contrast dye
prepare.text: After a CT scan with contrast, urine iodine stays high for several weeks. Tell your doctor. The test may be moved.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Eat as usual, without large servings of seaweed or seafood the day before.

prepare.title: Supplements
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Ask your doctor if you should pause iodine.

prepare.title: Collection
prepare.text: Usually the first morning urine is tested. Sometimes the doctor asks for a 24-hour collection. Check which one.

steps: Get a sterile container from a pharmacy or the lab
In the morning, wash your hands and wash your genitals with water, without iodine soap
Pee into the container without touching its rim
Take the urine to the lab within a few hours
feel: Nothing unpleasant. It is a normal urine sample
It can be a little awkward to aim. Hold the container by the outside
after: You can eat and drink as usual right away
One result can change from day to day. The doctor sometimes repeats the test

faq.q: Can I eat iodized salt before the test?
faq.a: Yes, eat as usual. The test should reflect your normal diet.

faq.q: Does a CT scan with contrast affect the result?
faq.a: Yes, a lot. Tell your doctor if you had a CT scan in the last few weeks.

reminders.text: Urine iodine test tomorrow. Collect the first morning urine in a sterile container and take it to the lab within a few hours.
